scope: Uniform whole-mesh CC topology with spatially varying point placement; not adaptive topology refinement or Task26 route-fold continuation.

measurement.station_center: Mean CURRENT XYZ of persistent actual station-ring corners; authored coordinates are never reapplied.
measurement.section_width_depth: Extents of CURRENT side mesh intersected by the current center plane. Nonplanar quad measurement uses a rotation/reflection-invariant centroid fan; saved quads remain unchanged.
measurement.face_center_normal_area: Current COMPAS face_centroid and face_normal; current unsigned centroid-fan area from saved vertices. R4 does not use signed-reference COMPAS face_area.
measurement.longitudinal: (current centroid coordinate - current first station coordinate) / current station span; Z for columns, X for lintel.
measurement.T: Unit difference of adjacent CURRENT section-center positions.
measurement.W: Current section width interpolated at current face centroid along the part.
measurement.C: clip(1-W/Wbody,0,1), with current body station width; lintel body reference is its current median thickness.
measurement.E: clip((W/Wneck-1)/3,0,1), with current neck station width; lintel uses its current median thickness.
measurement.S: Current section-width derivative along current station positions, interpolated at the face centroid and clipped to [-2,2].
measurement.K: Mean over actual face neighbors of clip((1-dot(current unit normals))/2,0,1). Added for R3.
measurement.h: sqrt(sum of unsigned CURRENT centroid-fan triangle areas); invariant to cyclic rotation, reversed cycle and reflection, including folded/nonplanar quads. R4 corrects COMPAS signed-reference polygon-area measurement.
measurement.sharpness: Maximum current crease attribute of incident face edges, zero in all four paths; no crease network is active.
measurement.ancestry: Actual coarse face source IDs, inherited semantic part/band and verified immediately previous V/F/E/E point origins. Geometry coefficients never replace positive semantic ancestry.

mapping.B: 0.65 for LINTEL; 1 for column sides; all BASE face parameters are exactly zero
mapping.point_assignment: Face wf/w3/w4 directly; edge w1/we arithmetic mean of its two current face rules; corner w2/wp mean of current incident face rules.
mapping.normals: Existing face extrusion uses unit face normal; edge extrusion uses mean neighboring face normals; corner extrusion normalizes the incident mean.
mapping.equation4: P=((V*(1+w3)+F*(1-w3))*(1+w4)+(E1+E2)*(1-w4))/4 + wf*n; only verified prior-CC child quads are eligible. G0 has no prior origins, so G1 uses existing face centroid placement plus wf instead.
mapping.standard_control: Existing crease_subdivide_once with empty networks, all extra weights/displacement disabled.
mapping.static: Compute all mapped face values at G0 only; every actual child inherits its parent's values exactly. Current observations are saved for diagnostics, never consumed by its next mapping.
mapping.dynamic: Read the immediately previous saved mesh/state, measure current sections/centroids/normals/area/K and remap every generation. Generation number is recorded, not used as a strength multiplier.
